description:
Read-only view of the organization this key or app acts in: the organization (get), its verified domains, SCIM provisioning, one member's sessions, service accounts, and the Slack workspaces, Microsoft Teams tenants and Zapier accounts added to the account (apps). Changes are made in the portal, never here.

Pass action: one of get, domains, scim, member_sessions, service_accounts, apps. Each action takes only its own arguments.
- get: The organization of the workspace this key or app acts in: its name, your role, its workspaces, verified domains, whether single sign-on is set up or required, whether SCIM provisioning is connected, its sign-in rules, and whether service accounts are available. Needs organization:read. Read-only: changes are made in the portal (Settings, Organization). No other arguments. Read-only; needs organization:read.
- domains: The email domains the organization has added, each with its state (pending, verified, warning, failed) and the DNS TXT record that proves it. Organization admins only; needs organization:read. Read-only. No other arguments. Read-only; needs organization:read.
- scim: Whether the organization's identity provider (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID) provisions people through SCIM: the base URL, how many people and groups it has sent, the default role, and its tokens (labels and prefixes, never the tokens). Organization admins only; needs organization:read. Read-only: tokens are made and replaced by a person in the portal. No other arguments. Read-only; needs organization:read.
- member_sessions: Where one person in the organization is signed in: each live web or app session with how it started (email, passkey, single sign-on…), its country and when it was last used. Organization admins only; needs members:read. Read-only: signing someone out happens in the portal, or with members:write through the API. Arguments: user_id (required). Read-only; needs members:read.
- service_accounts: The organization's service accounts: machine identities it owns (not a person), each with its workspace, scopes, daily and per-question caps in credits, today's spend, how it signs in and when it last got a token. Never their secrets. Needs organization:read. Read-only: an organization admin makes, changes and turns them off in the portal (Settings, Organization, Service accounts). No other arguments. Read-only; needs organization:read.
- apps: The Slack workspaces and Microsoft Teams tenants this account has added 50heads to (provider says which): each one's name, its daily spend cap and what it has spent today (in credits, UTC day), who added it and when. Also the Zapier accounts connected to it, each with its daily cap, today's spend and live hooks (one per Zap trigger). Asks from Slack, Teams or Zapier spend this account's credits within that cap. Read-only: a person adds, changes or removes them in the portal (Settings, Integrations). No other arguments. Read-only; needs apps:read.

action.description: What to do. One of: get, domains, scim, member_sessions, service_accounts, apps. Each action takes its own arguments; see the tool description.

user_id.description: The person's user id (from audit list, actor_id, or the portal's People list). (Used by: member_sessions.)

name: organization

role.description: Yours here: admin when you own or administer one of its workspaces.

scim_active.description: True when an identity provider has a working SCIM token; null when SCIM is not available.

service_accounts_available.description: True when service accounts and organization scopes are on for it.

single_sign_on.description: Null when not set up; absent when single sign-on is not available to it.

verified_domains.description: Domains it has proved with a DNS record.

state.description: warning: the record went missing and the grace period is running.

txt_record_value.description: The TXT value that proves it; safe to show to the people who manage DNS.

base_url.description: Where the identity provider sends SCIM requests.

live_secrets.description: Client secrets that work now (never the secrets themselves).

cap_daily_credits.description: Most the workspace may spend in a UTC day, in credits.

default_channel.description: Where results go when a question was not asked from a channel; null when none is set.

installed_by.description: Who added it: a name, or an email address when there is no name.

spent_today_credits.description: Spent so far today (UTC), in credits.

workspace_id.description: The Slack workspace (team) id, or the Microsoft Teams tenant id.

zapier.description: Zapier accounts connected to this account.

cap_daily_credits.description: Most this connection may spend in a UTC day, in credits.

connected_by.description: Who connected it: a name, or an email address when there is no name.

connection_id.description: The connection's id, conn_…; removing it in the portal also deletes its hooks.

hooks.description: Live REST hooks, one per Zap trigger.

spent_today_credits.description: Spent so far today (UTC), in credits.

title: Organization and workspace apps
